title: Courses and qualifications for 14 to 19 year olds
description: Find out what vocational or academic courses and qualifications are available at schools, colleges and sixth forms in your area
text:
# Courses and qualifications for 14 to 19 year olds

Get help choosing a course and free advice from the
National Careers Service.

## Exams helpline

Contact the National Careers Service Exam Results Helpline for free advice if you've received exams results that weren't as good as you were expecting.

The helpline is open from A level results day until a week after GCSE results day.

National Careers Service Exam Results Helpline

0800 100 900
